purpose: Matched original mature/spent natural clump artwork only; parent implements actual gatherAt/memory/regrowth linkage.

authoringObservations.shadeRoot: Item.ShadeRoot describes round edible root of a black-leaf low-light plant. Terrain.ShadePlot is an actual cultivated plot and uses cropArt av_crop_shade stages ahead of groundObjectArt complete_crop_shade and Def visual mushrooms.
authoringObservations.ashBerry: Item.AshBerry/Terrain.AshBerryBush use real summer eligibility and original regrow clock; current visual has one original bush sprite and may shrink it for depletion.

requiredStateRules: Apply these families only to the parent's intended natural forage terrain/source. Do not globally overwrite cultivated ShadePlot growth stages or soil/cultivation rules to make a wild clump.

Choose the state using the actual visible original source's availability and original gatherAt/cultivation/season rules. The picture never creates items, changes a clock, matures a plant or consumes food.
Keep the same original variant0..3across mature/spent/regrowth. Use existing stable tile/map identity; never draw RNG on rendering or swap to an unrelated crown on each visit.

Use the exact per-frame basal/root anchor and one sharedScale per matched pair. The spent crop is intentionally smaller because leaves/fruit/root food are gone; never independently fit spent to16px or apply the old extra0.6depletion shrink.
All leaves/fruit/root fibres are complete within source crop. Do not hide clipping with a small scale or recolor mature artwork as a fake spent state.
Unseen remembered cells keep the last legitimately observed state/variant. Do not recompute an off-screen plant from the current clock or expose harvest/regrowth changes through memory.
For a never observed field, use the game's existing fog/unknown handling. Do not infer an available mature source from an unknown icon.
Only actual parent Core transitions can return the same original source from spent to mature. No renderer timer, page reload, map reentry or animation allocates fresh harvest stock.
The metadata describes a16world-pixel logical footprint with maximum14pxwidth/12pxheight. It does not change collision, cover, sight, soil, movement, season, animal diet or resource yield.
